name: Deep Learning Architectures & Frameworks (PyTorch / TF)
description: Deep learning fundamentals, PyTorch autograd and modules, CNNs, Sequence models (RNN/LSTM/GRU), Transformer self-attention mechanisms, Autoencoders, and custom layers/loss implementations.

subskills.name: PyTorch Core, Tensors, Autograd & nn.Module
subskills.description: Tensors, GPU memory allocation (cuda), autograd computation graph, forward pass, backward pass, zero_grad(), and torch.nn.Module.

subskills.name: Feedforward Networks, BatchNorm & Dropout
subskills.description: Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLP), activations (ReLU, GELU, Swish), Batch Normalization, Layer Normalization, and Dropout regularization.

subskills.name: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) & Computer Vision
subskills.description: 2D/3D Convolutions, kernels, stride, padding, pooling, ResNet residual blocks, ConvNeXt, and receptive field mechanics.

subskills.name: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN, LSTM & GRU)
subskills.description: Vanishing/exploding gradient in RNNs, LSTM cell states, gates (forget, input, output), GRU update/reset gates, and bidirectional RNNs.

subskills.name: Transformer Architecture & Scaled Dot-Product Attention
subskills.description: Self-attention formula QK^T / sqrt(d_k), Multi-Head Attention, positional encodings (Sinusoidal, RoPE), and Encoder-Decoder blocks.

subskills.name: Autoencoders & Variational Autoencoders (VAE)
subskills.description: Bottleneck representations, reconstruction loss, Variational Autoencoders (VAE), latent space distribution, and reparameterization trick.

subskills.name: Custom PyTorch Layers & Differentiable Loss Functions
subskills.description: Writing custom torch.autograd.Function with explicit forward/backward methods, custom loss functions, and parameterized module layers.

subskills.name: Training Loops, PyTorch Lightning & Callbacks
subskills.description: Structuring clean training loops, PyTorch Lightning LightningModule & Trainer, EarlyStopping, ModelCheckpoint, and mixed-precision (AMP).

subskills.name: Distributed Training (DDP, FSDP & DeepSpeed)
subskills.description: DistributedDataParallel (DDP), gradient all-reduce, Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP), ZeRO stages in DeepSpeed, and multi-GPU scaling.

cv.signal: Built custom deep learning architectures in PyTorch with distributed training (DDP) across GPU clusters

linkedin.signal: PyTorch, Deep Learning, and Neural Networks specialist endorsements

assessment.signal: Passes Deep Learning Architectures & PyTorch Frameworks Assessment

junior.description: Writes PyTorch tensors and modules, configures standard layers (BatchNorm, Dropout), and manages training loops with PyTorch Lightning.

mid.description: Constructs CNNs and LSTMs/GRUs, writes custom loss functions and autograd layers, and builds Variational Autoencoders.

senior.description: Architects custom Transformer multi-head attention systems and scales multi-GPU distributed training using DDP, FSDP, and DeepSpeed.
